memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "However, if it is not done intentionally, but God lets it happen, they are to flee to a place I will designate. But if anyone schemes and kills someone deliberately, that person is to be taken from my altar and put to death." - Exodus 21:13-14 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
God's justice is never blunt or careless. Here He draws a careful line between an accident and a murder. If a death happened without intention, the person could flee to a place of refuge. But if someone plotted and killed with cold purpose, no altar could shield him. God sees not only the deed but the intention behind it. He weighs the heart.

What a comfort and a warning this is. A comfort, because our God is not a harsh judge who lumps the careless mistake together with the calculated crime. He knows the difference between the person who stumbles and the person who schemes. A warning, because He is not fooled by outward appearances; He reads the hidden motives we think are safely concealed.

This is exactly the God we meet in Jesus, who looked past the surface into people's hearts. Nothing is hidden from Him (Heb 4:13). And that truth drives us to the cross, where the God who sees every scheme also offers full forgiveness. We cannot hide from Him — but in Christ, we do not need to.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
What hidden motives in my heart do I need to bring honestly before God?
Does it comfort or unsettle me that God sees my true intentions?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, You see past my actions into my heart. Cleanse my hidden motives, and thank You that in Christ I need not hide from You but can come freely for grace. Amen.
